name: traj
meaning: Scn_GetPropTrajectory(TRAJ): the path

name: follower
meaning: path follower (speed 500, or 250 with WALK; bias 0x800; continuous; 3-D; arrive radius 50); pointIndex at +0x84

name: state
meaning: CrocodileLevel09State

name: stateAfterTurn
meaning: direction state (2 or 3) resumed when the turn (state 5) ends

name: prevState
meaning: state before the last SetState; drives the waypoint bookkeeping

name: moveAnim
meaning: walk/run anim id: 7 when PROPERTY_CROCODILELEVEL09_WALK is set, else 3

name: waypoint
meaning: trajectory point currently steered to

name: otherWaypoint
meaning: last waypoint reached; swapped with waypoint when the direction reverses

name: swapTmp
meaning: scratch for the waypoint swap

name: spinSpeed
meaning: state 7 per-frame yaw step, 0x22b decaying by 1/4 each frame

name: startFacing
meaning: facing along the first path segment (+0x800, unmasked); restored by Reset

name: angleToWolf
meaning: atan angle from the croc to the Wolf (12-bit, no +0x800)

name: bounceEntryVert
meaning: bouncer's y when it entered deathBox; 0x8000 = none

name: homePos
meaning: trajectory point 0, ground-snapped

name: moveDelta
meaning: per-frame displacement (ScaleByDt of the follower velocity), resolved by MoveAndTilt

name: scratchVec
meaning: first-segment vector at Init, then Wolf - croc

name: pointCount
meaning: traj->count, number of path points

name: deathBoxCount
meaning: object count in deathBox on the previous frame (dead state); a rise triggers a scan

name: activationBox
meaning: Scn_GetPropBox(ACTIVATIONBOX); dereferenced without a NULL check

name: deathBox
meaning: world box of the corpse: model box 0 scaled x/z *150/80 and y *200/80, offset by pos

name: bouncer
meaning: Wolf or FloatingBox that entered deathBox, pending the bounce test
